ss1_sub: A password generator for the Mac menu bar. Fully offline, stores no passwords, clears the clipboard after 30 seconds.
ss3_sub: Random, Phrase, PIN, Syllables and Key. Strength is computed exactly, never inflated.

What happens after,

in the menu bar
p1_desc: The sandbox has no network entitlement. Website rules ship inside the app and are looked up on your Mac.
